name: ziwei-doushu
description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
one_liner: An open-source engine, plus a huge dataset of chart interpretations, for casting and reading charts in Zi Wei Dou Shu, a traditional Chinese astrology system.
buyer: A Chinese-language fortune-telling app or content creator who wants an accurate, automated chart-casting engine instead of hiring astrologers to write readings by hand.
business_use_cases: A mobile app for Chinese-speaking users offers automated birth-chart readings as a freemium feature, using this engine instead of manual calculation.
A content creator or astrology influencer uses the dataset to generate shareable daily or personalized readings at scale for social media.
A matchmaking or relationship app in the Chinese market adds a compatibility-reading feature built on this chart engine as a differentiator.

money_ideas.idea: Launch a freemium app: free basic chart, paid detailed reading or ongoing 'yearly fortune' updates.
Sell one-off, nicely formatted PDF or shareable-image readings generated from the engine.

steal_this: Build a simple web app: enter a birthdate, get an instant, nicely designed Zi Wei Dou Shu chart reading, charge a few dollars for the detailed version.
